criteria.mastery_indicator: Student recognizes that field lines require a charged source object.
common_misconceptions: Any neutral sphere should create field lines.
Charging is only a visual effect.

criteria.mastery_indicator: Student explains field direction as the force direction on a positive test charge.
common_misconceptions: Field direction is the direction the field line was drawn by the software.
Positive and negative charges have the same field direction.

criteria.mastery_indicator: Student links denser field lines with stronger field magnitude.
common_misconceptions: Every point on a field line has the same field strength.
Longer field lines mean stronger field.

criteria.mastery_indicator: Student explains the net electric field as a vector sum from both charges.
common_misconceptions: Fields cancel everywhere between opposite charges.
